name: linkedin-jobs-mcp-server
description: Search and inspect LinkedIn jobs through a local, browser-backed MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Search, inspect and track LinkedIn jobs.
interface.longDescription: Use your own LinkedIn browser session to search jobs, read postings, inspect application methods and Easy Apply forms, and track saved jobs in Codex. Independent open-source project. Not affiliated with LinkedIn or Microsoft. LinkedIn is a trademark of LinkedIn Corporation.
defaultPrompt: Find remote Python jobs posted this week.
Read a LinkedIn job posting and summarize its requirements.
List the jobs I have in progress on LinkedIn.
